questions.question: Which of the following are key messages for Product X in the cardiology segment? (Select all that apply)
options: Improved patient adherence vs. standard of care
Once-daily dosing with proven efficacy in Phase III trials
Contraindicated in patients with mild hypertension
questions.explanation: Core messaging focuses on adherence, dosing convenience, and clinical evidence. Product X is indicated for adults, not pediatrics.

questions.question: A physician asks about drug-drug interactions with common statins. What is the correct response?
options: No clinically significant interactions have been observed in the label
Product X must never be co-prescribed with any statin
Recommend the physician consult the full PI section 7
Interactions are unknown — defer to medical affairs on every call
questions.explanation: Always direct HCPs to the Prescribing Information. Section 7 covers drug interactions; medical affairs supports complex cases.

questions.question: What is the approved indication for Product X?
options: Reduction of cardiovascular risk in adults with type 2 diabetes
Treatment of acute migraine in adolescents
Management of chronic lower back pain
questions.explanation: Reps must stay within approved indication per promotional compliance guidelines.

questions.explanation: Self-assessment scale — rep completes before manager debrief; weight contributes to coaching score.
